items.title: LISI STRIPE
items.excerpt:
Explore the charm of AAKS with our Lisi Stripe, a bucket silhouette cross body bag crafted from natural woven raffia fibres. Enhanced with a leather cross body handle and raffia trim on the sides, this versatile bag can be carried over the shoulder or across the body. 

• Size: H 18 cm x W 12.5cm
• Woven Raffia Bag
• Leather detailing
• Linen Lining with Inner pocket
• Drawstring Closure
• All our bags are handcrafted in Ghana

items.title: SCALLOP TOTE
items.excerpt:
Anchored in artisanal craftsmanship, the AAKS brand speaks to the power, fearlessness and sensuality of the modern woman. This large top handle raffia tote has a trapezoid silhouette made of woven raffia fibres with leather detailing and a braided dual handle. Fit all your summer necessities in your bag for a day at the beach.

• Size: H 34 cm x W 57cm
• Woven Raffia Bag
• Leather detailing
• Linen Lining with Inner pocket
• Drawstring Closure
• All our bags are handcrafted in Ghana

Complete with a linen lining and pocket, it's the ideal companion for a minimalistic summer ensemble. Elevate your style with AAKS bags – compact, trendy, and perfect for your petite carryables.

• Leather detailing

• Drawstring Closure

items.title: BELLA LAMP
items.excerpt:
Artisanal textiles are woven together to form a highly refined classic silhouette, allowing our Bella pendant lamp to transcend a variety of interior styles working harmoniously in a traditional, contemporary or a minimal environment. It creates a timeless yet playful lighting solution, adding warmth to any space. It is composed of straw, hand-dyed yarns and it’s finished off with a bronze plate and ring to hold the bulb and wire fittings in place.

H: 20cm W: 35cm

Components: Natural Straw, Hand Dyed Cotton Yarns, Bronze Detailing and Wrapped Leather.

*Each pendant is sold separately without wiring or bulbs. A bronze suspension ring is provided to hold wire and bulb in place once assembled. LED bulbs are recommended. Order times: Orders need to be made at least 1 month before the intended delivery date.

Download the brochure with full story on ‘Weaving for Change’

items.title: OUDE LAMP
items.excerpt:
The simplicity of the Oude Lamp evolved from the desire to create a timeless and quietly opulent lighting solution. Whether as a single piece or clustered in a cascading tier; this is an arresting and sculptural shade which never fails to add presence and elegance. Ideal for bedrooms and social spaces. It is composed of straw, hand-dyed yarns, bronze plate and finished off with a bronze ring to hold the bulb and wire fittings in place.*
